```{r}
gabon_union <- st_union(shp_gabon)

spatial_data_gab <- spatial_data_gab %>% st_transform(3857)

spatial_data_gab_sp     <- as(spatial_data_gab, "Spatial")
gabon_union_sp <- as(gabon_union, "Spatial")

coords_gabon<- coordinates(spatial_data_gab_sp)


mesh_gabon <- inla.mesh.2d(
  loc      = coords_gabon,
  boundary = inla.sp2segment(gabon_union_sp),
  max.edge = c(25e3, 200e3),   
  cutoff   = 40e3,
  offset   = c(100e3, 200e3))

# Extract triangle vertex indices
tri <- mesh_gabon$graph$tv


# Build edges from triangles
edges_list <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(tri)) {
  idx <- tri[i, ]
  # Each triangle has 3 edges
  edges_list[[length(edges_list) + 1]] <- st_linestring(mesh_gabon$loc[idx[c(1,2)], 1:2])
  edges_list[[length(edges_list) + 1]] <- st_linestring(mesh_gabon$loc[idx[c(2,3)], 1:2])
  edges_list[[length(edges_list) + 1]] <- st_linestring(mesh_gabon$loc[idx[c(3,1)], 1:2])
}

mesh_edges_sf <- st_as_sf(st_sfc(edges_list, crs = 3857))

coords_df_gabon <- as.data.frame(coords_gabon)
colnames(coords_df_gabon) <- c("X", "Y")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = mesh_edges_sf, fill = NA, color = "grey60", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = gabon_union, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = coords_df_gabon, aes(X, Y), color = "red", size = 1.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Mesh for Gabon with Boundary")

```

```{r}
#1. Variables to be scale
vars_to_scale <- c(
  "pop_density_2020",
  "annual_temperature_2021",
  "annual_rainfall_2021",
  "elevation",
  "dist_to_water",
  "vegetation_index",
  "lc_water",
  "lc_built",
  "lc_cropland",
  "lc_wetland")

# 2. Create a named list to store the training parameters (Means and SDs)
scaling_stats <- list()

# 3. Scale the observed data and extract the parameters
for (var in vars_to_scale) {
  # Calculate mean and standard deviation from the 36 observed points
  mean_val <- mean(spatial_data_gab[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_val   <- sd(spatial_data_gab[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Store them for later use on the grid
  scaling_stats[[var]] <- c(mean = mean_val, sd = sd_val)
  
  # Apply the scaling to the observed data
  spatial_data_gab[[var]] <- (spatial_data_gab[[var]] - mean_val) / sd_val
  }
```

```{r}
snap <- function(x, nodes) nodes[max.col(-abs(outer(x, nodes, "-")))]

  nodes <- unique(quantile(spatial_data_gab[[v]], probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_nodes), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
make_effects <- function(d, covariates) {
  e <- data.frame(intercept = rep(1, nrow(d)))
  for (v in covariates) {
    e[[v]] <- d[[v]]
    e[[paste0(v, "_id")]] <- d[[paste0(v, "_id")]]
  }
  e
}

make_formula <- function(covariates, type = c("linear", "nonlinear")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  rhs <- if (type == "linear") {
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  } else {
    paste0("f(", covariates, "_id, model = 'rw2')", collapse = " + ")
  }
  as.formula(paste("y ~ -1 + intercept +", rhs, "+ f(spatial, model = spde)"))
}
```

```{r}
fit_full_model <- function(data, covariates, mesh, spde, s.index,
                           type = c("linear", "nonlinear"), model_name = type) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  d <- st_drop_geometry(data)

  A <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc = as.matrix(d[, c("lon", "lat")]))

  stk <- inla.stack(
    data    = list(y = d$Number_of_infected_tot_pf,
                   Ntrials = d$Number_of_participant_tot),
    A       = list(A, 1),
    effects = list(spatial = s.index, make_effects(d, covariates)),
    tag     = "est")

  fit <- inla(make_formula(covariates, type),
              family  = "betabinomial",
              data    = inla.stack.data(stk),
              Ntrials = inla.stack.data(stk)$Ntrials,
              control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(stk), compute = TRUE),
              control.fixed     = list(mean = 0, prec = 0.2),
              control.compute   = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
              num.threads = "1:1")

  # pointwise values (estimation rows only, since this stack has no prediction rows)
  idx    <- inla.stack.index(stk, "est")$data
  waic_i <- fit$waic$local.waic[idx]
  dic_i  <- fit$dic$local.dic[idx]
  lcpo_i <- log(fit$cpo$cpo[idx])
  lcpo_i[fit$cpo$failure[idx] > 0] <- NA        # drop unreliable CPOs

  se_sum  <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]; sqrt(length(x) * var(x)) }
  se_mean <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]; sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)) }

  summary_tab <- data.frame(
    model  = model_name,
    metric = c("WAIC", "DIC", "LogCPO (mean)"),
    est    = c(fit$waic$waic, fit$dic$dic, mean(lcpo_i, na.rm = TRUE)),
    se     = c(se_sum(waic_i), se_sum(dic_i), se_mean(lcpo_i)))
  summary_tab$lower <- summary_tab$est - 1.96 * summary_tab$se
  summary_tab$upper <- summary_tab$est + 1.96 * summary_tab$se

  list(fit = fit, summary = summary_tab,
       pointwise = data.frame(waic = waic_i, dic = dic_i, lcpo = lcpo_i))
}

# Paired comparison of two models fitted on the same data
# (positive diff in WAIC/DIC => model A is worse; positive in LogCPO => model A is better)
compare_insample <- function(resA, resB) {
  f <- function(x, y) {
    d <- x - y; d <- d[is.finite(d)]
    c(diff = sum(d), se = sqrt(length(d)) * sd(d))
  }
  rbind(WAIC = f(resA$pointwise$waic, resB$pointwise$waic),
        DIC  = f(resA$pointwise$dic,  resB$pointwise$dic),
        LogCPO_sum = f(resA$pointwise$lcpo, resB$pointwise$lcpo))
}
```


```{r}
make_folds <- function(n, K = 2, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n))
}

run_cv <- function(data, covariates, mesh, spde, s.index,
                   type = c("linear", "nonlinear"), model_name = type,
                   folds, S = 100, seed = 123, B = 1000) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  K <- length(unique(folds))
  data$fold   <- folds
  data$obs_id <- seq_len(nrow(data))
  formula <- make_formula(covariates, type)

  fold_results <- list(); pointwise <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(K)) {
    train <- st_drop_geometry(filter(data, fold != i))
    test  <- st_drop_geometry(filter(data, fold == i))

    A_train <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc = as.matrix(train[, c("lon", "lat")]))
    A_test  <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc = as.matrix(test[,  c("lon", "lat")]))

    stack.est <- inla.stack(
      data = list(y = train$Number_of_infected_tot_pf,
                  Ntrials = train$Number_of_participant_tot),
      A = list(A_train, 1),
      effects = list(spatial = s.index, make_effects(train, covariates)), tag = "est")
    stack.pred <- inla.stack(
      data = list(y = NA, Ntrials = test$Number_of_participant_tot),
      A = list(A_test, 1),
      effects = list(spatial = s.index, make_effects(test, covariates)), tag = "pred")
    stk <- inla.stack(stack.est, stack.pred)

    fit <- inla(formula, family = "betabinomial",
                data = inla.stack.data(stk), Ntrials = inla.stack.data(stk)$Ntrials,
                control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(stk), compute = TRUE, link = 1),
                control.fixed = list(mean = 0, prec = 0.2),
                control.compute = list(config = TRUE),
                num.threads = "1:1",
                control.inla = list(control.vb = list(enable = FALSE)))

    # ---- posterior samples
    idx.pred <- inla.stack.index(stk, "pred")$data
    samples  <- inla.posterior.sample(S, fit, seed = 123L, num.threads = "1:1")
    eta <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(function(idx) APredictor[idx], samples, idx = idx.pred)
    p   <- plogis(eta)                                    # n_test x S

    # rho <- sapply(samples, function(s) s$hyperpar[grep("overdispersion", names(s$hyperpar))])
    # if (any(rho < 0 | rho > 1)) rho <- plogis(rho)        # in case of internal scale
    # k <- (1 - rho) / rho
    # a <- sweep(p,     2, k, "*")
    # b <- sweep(1 - p, 2, k, "*")

    n <- test$Number_of_participant_tot
    y <- test$Number_of_infected_tot_pf

    # ---- posterior predictive counts -> coverage
    # set.seed(seed + i)
    # pi_rep <- matrix(rbeta(length(a), a, b), nrow = nrow(a))
    # y_rep  <- matrix(rbinom(length(pi_rep), rep(n, times = ncol(a)), pi_rep), nrow = nrow(a))
    # lo <- apply(y_rep, 1, quantile, 0.025, type = 1)
    # hi <- apply(y_rep, 1, quantile, 0.975, type = 1)
    # in_pi <- y >= lo & y <= hi

    # ---- held-out log predictive density (exact betabinomial pmf)
    # lp  <- lchoose(n, y) + lbeta(y + a, n - y + b) - lbeta(a, b)
    # mx  <- apply(lp, 1, max)
    # lpd <- mx + log(rowMeans(exp(lp - mx)))

    # ---- point-prediction metrics
    obs_prev  <- y / n
    pred_mean <- rowMeans(p)

    fold_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
      fold = i,
      # ELPD        = mean(lpd),
      RMSE        = sqrt(mean((obs_prev - pred_mean)^2)),
      MAE         = mean(abs(obs_prev - pred_mean)),
      Correlation = cor(obs_prev, pred_mean)
      # Coverage95  = mean(in_pi)
      )

    pointwise[[i]] <- data.frame(obs_id = test$obs_id, fold = i, obs_prev = obs_prev, pred = pred_mean)
  }

  folds_df <- do.call(rbind, fold_results)    # per-fold values (just 2 rows, no CI)
  pw       <- do.call(rbind, pointwise)       # every observation held out exactly once

  # ---- pooled metrics + bootstrap CI over held-out observations
  metrics_fn <- function(d) c(
    # ELPD        = mean(d$lpd),
    RMSE        = sqrt(mean((d$obs_prev - d$pred)^2)),
    MAE         = mean(abs(d$obs_prev - d$pred)),
    Correlation = cor(d$obs_prev, d$pred)
    # Coverage95  = mean(d$in_pi)
    )

  set.seed(seed)
  est  <- metrics_fn(pw)
  boot <- replicate(B, metrics_fn(pw[sample(nrow(pw), replace = TRUE), ]))

  summary_tab <- data.frame(
    model  = model_name,
    metric = names(est),
    est    = unname(est),
    lower  = apply(boot, 1, quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper  = apply(boot, 1, quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    row.names = NULL)

  list(folds = folds_df, pointwise = pw, summary = summary_tab)
}
```

```{r}
full_results <- list()

for (m in names(candidate_models)) {
  for (tp in c("linear", "nonlinear")) {
    nm <- paste(m, tp)
    message("Fitting ", nm)
    full_results[[nm]] <- fit_full_model(
      data       = spatial_data_gab,
      covariates = candidate_models[[m]],
      mesh = mesh, spde = spde, s.index = s.index,
      type = tp, model_name = nm)
  }
}

insample_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(full_results, `[[`, "summary"))
insample_tab

folds <- make_folds(nrow(spatial_data_gab), K = 2, seed = 123)
cv_results <- list()
for (m in names(candidate_models)) {
  for (tp in c("linear", "nonlinear")) {
    nm <- paste(m, tp)
    message("Fitting ", nm)
    cv_results[[nm]] <- run_cv(
      data       = spatial_data_gab,
      covariates = candidate_models[[m]],
      mesh = mesh, spde = spde, s.index = s.index,
      type = tp, model_name = nm,
      folds = folds)
  }
}

cv_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cv_results, `[[`, "summary"))
cv_tab

insample_tab1 <- insample_tab |> select(-se)

result_final <- cv_tab |> 
  bind_rows(insample_tab1)

metrics_select <- c("RMSE", "MAE", "LogCPO (mean)")


result_final1 <- result_final |> 
  filter(metric %in% metrics_select)


higher_better <- c("LogCPO (mean)")

# Identify best model in each metric
result_final2 <- result_final1 %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(Best = if(metric[1] %in% higher_better) {
    est == max(est, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      est == min(est, na.rm = TRUE)
    }) %>%
  arrange(est, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Model_ordered = factor(model, levels = model)) %>%
  ungroup()

Model_selec <- ggplot(result_final2, aes(x = est, y = Model_ordered, colour = Best)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    height = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Model Comparison Forest Plot",
    x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

ggsave("Outputs/gab_output/Model_selection_criterials_PF.png",
       plot = Model_selec, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}

nl_vars <- c(
    "vegetation_index",
    "dist_to_water",
    "pop_density_2020")

n_dat <- nrow(spatial_data_gab)

for (var in vars_to_scale) {
  mean_val <- scaling_stats[[var]]["mean"]
  sd_val   <- scaling_stats[[var]]["sd"]
  
  grid_sf_gabon[[var]] <- (grid_sf_gabon[[var]] - mean_val) / sd_val
  }

# Flag cells inside or outside the sampled range

for (v in nl_vars) {
  rng <- range(spatial_data_gab[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  spatial_data_gab[[paste0(v, "_raw")]] <- spatial_data_gab[[v]]
  grid_sf_gabon[[paste0(v, "_raw")]]    <- grid_sf_gabon[[v]]   # keep the real values
  
  grid_sf_gabon[[paste0(v, "_extrap")]] <- grid_sf_gabon[[v]] < rng[1] | grid_sf_gabon[[v]] > rng[2]

  grid_sf_gabon[[v]] <- pmin(pmax(grid_sf_gabon[[v]], rng[1]), rng[2])
}

# One overall flag: TRUE only if the cell is inside the range for ALL covariates
extrap_cols <- paste0(nl_vars, "_extrap")
grid_sf_gabon$in_range <- !apply(st_drop_geometry(grid_sf_gabon)[, extrap_cols], 1, any)

# How much of the country is supported?
colMeans(st_drop_geometry(grid_sf_gabon)[, extrap_cols])   # share extrapolated, per covariate
mean(grid_sf_gabon$in_range)                               # share fully supported

raw_vars <- paste0(nl_vars, "_raw")
n_nodes <- 3

snap <- function(x, nodes) nodes[max.col(-abs(outer(x, nodes, "-")))]

for (v in nl_vars) {
  nodes <- unique(quantile(spatial_data_gab[[v]], probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_nodes), na.rm = TRUE))
  spatial_data_gab[[paste0(v, "_id")]] <- snap(spatial_data_gab[[v]], nodes)
  grid_sf_gabon[[paste0(v, "_id")]]    <- snap(grid_sf_gabon[[v]],    nodes)
}

# for (v in nl_vars) {
#   all_vals <- c(spatial_data_gab[[v]], grid_sf_gabon[[v]])   
#   grp <- inla.group(all_vals, n = 25, method = "quantile")
#   spatial_data_gab[[paste0(v, "_id")]] <- grp[seq_len(n_dat)]
#   grid_sf_gabon[[paste0(v, "_id")]]    <- grp[-seq_len(n_dat)]}

# check: about 25 levels each
sapply(paste0(nl_vars, "_id"), function(x)
  length(unique(c(spatial_data_gab[[x]], grid_sf_gabon[[x]]))))


id_vars <- paste0(nl_vars, "_id")

A_est  <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh_gabon, loc = st_coordinates(spatial_data_gab))
A_pred <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh_gabon, loc = st_coordinates(grid_sf_gabon))
s.index <- inla.spde.make.index("spatial", n.spde = spde_Gabon$n.spde)

# raw_vars <- paste0(nl_vars, "_raw")
# 
effects_est  <- data.frame(intercept = 1, st_drop_geometry(spatial_data_gab)[, nl_vars])
effects_pred <- data.frame(intercept = 1, st_drop_geometry(grid_sf_gabon)[, nl_vars])

# effects_est  <- data.frame(intercept = 1, st_drop_geometry(spatial_data_gab)[, raw_vars])
# effects_pred <- data.frame(intercept = 1, st_drop_geometry(grid_sf_gabon)[, raw_vars])

# effects_est  <- data.frame(intercept = 1, st_drop_geometry(spatial_data_gab)[, id_vars])
# effects_pred <- data.frame(intercept = 1, st_drop_geometry(grid_sf_gabon)[, id_vars])

stk_est <- inla.stack(
  data    = list(y = spatial_data_gab$Number_of_infected_microscopy_tot_pm,
                 Ntrials = spatial_data_gab$Number_of_participant_tot),
  A       = list(A_est, 1),
  effects = list(s.index, effects_est),
  tag     = "est")

stk_pred <- inla.stack(
  data    = list(y = NA, Ntrials = rep(1, nrow(grid_sf_gabon))),
  A       = list(A_pred, 1),
  effects = list(s.index, effects_pred),
  tag     = "pred")

stk_full <- inla.stack(stk_est, stk_pred)

```


```{r}

# rw2_prior <- list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(1, 0.01)))

# formula <- y ~ -1 + intercept +
#   f(vegetation_index_id, model = "rw2", scale.model = TRUE, hyper = rw2_prior) +
#   f(dist_to_water_id,        model = "rw2", scale.model = TRUE, hyper = rw2_prior) +
#   f(pop_density_2020_id,           model = "rw2", scale.model = TRUE, hyper = rw2_prior) +
#   f(spatial, model = spde_Gabon)


formula <- y ~ -1 + intercept + vegetation_index + dist_to_water + pop_density_2020 +
  f(spatial, model = spde_Gabon)

# formula <- y ~ -1 + intercept + f(spatial, model = spde_Gabon)

res_inla <- inla(
  formula,
  family  = "betabinomial",
  data    = inla.stack.data(stk_full),
  Ntrials = inla.stack.data(stk_full)$Ntrials,
  control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(stk_full), compute = TRUE, link = 1),
  control.fixed     = list(mean = 0, prec = 1,
                           mean.intercept = qlogis(0.2111),
                           prec.intercept = 1),
  control.compute   = list(config = TRUE),
  verbose = TRUE)          # lets you see that it is progressing

pred_idx <- inla.stack.index(stk_full, "pred")$data

samples <- inla.posterior.sample(500, res_inla, seed = 123L)

eta_mat  <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(function() APredictor[pred_idx], samples)
prob_mat <- plogis(eta_mat)


# eta_mat <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(
#   function() APredictor[pred_idx],
#   inla.posterior.sample(100, res_inla))
# 
# prob_mat <- plogis(eta_mat)

pred_mean  <- rowMeans(prob_mat)
pred_sd    <- apply(prob_mat, 1, sd)
pred_q025  <- apply(prob_mat, 1, quantile, 0.025)
pred_q975  <- apply(prob_mat, 1, quantile, 0.975)


grid_sf_gabon$pred_mean <- pred_mean
grid_sf_gabon$mean_pr   <- res_inla$summary.fitted.values$mean[pred_idx]
grid_sf_gabon$pred_sd   <- pred_sd
grid_sf_gabon$pred_q025  <- pred_q025
grid_sf_gabon$pred_q975  <- pred_q975

grid_sf_gabon_1 <- grid_sf_gabon |> 
  mutate(pred_mean_in  = ifelse(in_range, pred_mean, NA),
         pred_q025_in  = ifelse(in_range, pred_q025, NA),
         pred_q975_in  = ifelse(in_range, pred_q975, NA),
         pred_mean_out = ifelse(!in_range, pred_mean, NA),
         pred_q025_out = ifelse(!in_range, pred_q025, NA),
         pred_q975_out = ifelse(!in_range, pred_q975, NA))

select_cols <- c("pred_mean", "pred_q025", "pred_q975", "pred_mean_in", "pred_q025_in",
                 "pred_q975_in", "pred_mean_out", "pred_q025_out", "pred_q975_out", "in_range", "geom")
grid_sf_gabon_2 <- grid_sf_gabon_1 |> 
  select(all_of(select_cols))


res_inla$summary.fixed


```

```{r}
microscopy_raw_raster_pf1 <- microscopy_pf[[c("pred_mean_in", "pred_q025_in", "pred_q975_in")]]
names(microscopy_raw_raster_pf1) <- c("PRpm_comal", "lci", "uci")
microscopy_raw_raster_pf1$PRpm_pcr <- PCR_raster_pf$pred_mean_in

vect_gab <- vect(shp_gabon %>% st_transform(3857))
gab_pr_pm <- crop(microscopy_raw_raster_pf1, vect_gab)
gab_pr_pm <- mask(gab_pr_pm, vect_gab)
gab_pr_pm_df <- terra::extract(gab_pr_pm, vect_gab)
gab_pr_pm_df <- gab_pr_pm_df %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  mutate(PRpm_comal            = mean(PRpm_comal, na.rm = TRUE),
         PRpm_pcr              = mean(PRpm_pcr, na.rm = TRUE),
         lci                   = mean(lci, na.rm = TRUE),
         uci                   = mean(uci, na.rm = TRUE),
         CI_width              = uci - lci)%>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct()


gab_pr_pm_shp <- shp_gabon %>% 
  mutate(PRpm_comal                        = gab_pr_pm_df$PRpm_comal,
         PRpm_pcr                          = gab_pr_pm_df$PRpm_pcr,
         PmPR_L                            = gab_pr_pm_df$lci,
         PmPR_U                            = gab_pr_pm_df$uci,
         CI_width                          = gab_pr_pm_df$CI_width)
```


```{r}
pfpr_2021_africa <- rast("data/prevalence_2000/2025_GBD2024_Global_PfPR_2021.tif") 

names(pfpr_2021_africa) <- c("Prev_mean", " ", "lci", "uci")

gab_vect <- vect(shp_gabon |> st_transform(4326))

pfpr_2021_gab <- crop(pfpr_2021_africa, gab_vect)
pfpr_2021_gab <- mask(pfpr_2021_gab, gab_vect)


prev_dat_gab_2021 <- terra::extract(pfpr_2021_gab, gab_vect)

prev_summary <- prev_dat_gab_2021 %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(
    PfPR_2_10   = mean(Prev_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    PfPR_2_10_l = mean(lci, na.rm = TRUE),
    PfPR_2_10_u = mean(uci, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


prev_dat_gab_2021_sf <- shp_gabon %>% 
  mutate(PfPR_2_10   =  prev_summary$PfPR_2_10,
         PfPR_2_10_l = prev_summary$PfPR_2_10_l,
         PfPR_2_10_u = prev_summary$PfPR_2_10_u)


# Conversion of the prevalence to all age group

n <- nrow(prev_dat_gab_2021_sf)

prev_dat_gab_2021_sf$PR_all_age <- mapply(
  convertPrevalence,
  prev         = prev_dat_gab_2021_sf$PfPR_2_10,
  age_min_in   = rep(2, n),
  age_max_in   = rep(10, n),
  age_min_out  = rep(0, n),
  age_max_out  = rep(100, n),
  parameters   = "Pf_Smith2007"
)

prev_dat_gab_2021_sf$PR_all_age_U <- mapply(
  convertPrevalence,
  prev         = prev_dat_gab_2021_sf$PfPR_2_10_u,
  age_min_in   = rep(2, n),
  age_max_in   = rep(10, n),
  age_min_out  = rep(0, n),
  age_max_out  = rep(99, n),
  parameters   = "Pf_Smith2007")

prev_dat_gab_2021_sf$PR_all_age_L <- mapply(
  convertPrevalence,
  prev         = prev_dat_gab_2021_sf$PfPR_2_10_l,
  age_min_in   = rep(2, n),
  age_max_in   = rep(10, n),
  age_min_out  = rep(0, n),
  age_max_out  = rep(99, n),
  parameters   = "Pf_Smith2007")

gab_pr_pm_shp$PRpm_map <- prev_dat_gab_2021_sf$PR_all_age

gab_pr_pm_shp <- gab_pr_pm_shp |> 
  mutate(comal_map_microscopy = PRpm_comal - PRpm_map,
         comal_map_pcr        = PRpm_pcr   - PRpm_map)

gab_admin1 <- ggplot(gab_pr_pm_shp)+
  geom_sf(mapping = aes(fill = comal_map_microscopy))+
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = rev(brewer.pal(5, "RdYlGn")),
    breaks = c(-0.2, -0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.2),
    limits = c(-0.2, 0.2),
    name = "Difference in Prevalence",
    na.value = "transparent"
  )+
  theme_void()+
  labs(title = "Difference in prevalence COMAL (microscopy) vs MAP")

ggsave(
  "Outputs/gab_output/Pf_pr_estimated/diff_map_microscop_gabon_pf_raster.pdf",
       plot = gab_admin1, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)


gab_admin2 <- ggplot(gab_pr_pm_shp)+
  geom_sf(mapping = aes(fill = comal_map_pcr))+
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = rev(brewer.pal(5, "RdYlGn")),
    breaks = c(0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8),
    limits = c(0.4, 0.8),
    name = "Difference in Prevalence",
    na.value = "transparent"
  )+
  theme_void()+
  labs(title = "Difference in prevalence COMAL (PCR) vs MAP")

ggsave(
  "Outputs/gab_output/Pf_pr_estimated/diff_map_pcr_gabon_pf_raster.pdf",
       plot = gab_admin2, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
